rationale: The original short thesis remains fully intact: the broad market has weakened further since entry (SPY down -1.16% vs -0.98% at entry, VIXY up +4.83%), and SPCX continues to trade in the bottom 16.2% of its daily range well below a declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($152.07) and session VWAP ($152.38). After reaching a fresh session low of $150.56, the subsequent shallow bounce stalled at $151.66 and is already rolling back over toward $151.16 on consecutive lower 1-minute closes, showing sustained seller control. With our $152.50 invalidation safely above both the 9-EMA and VWAP, holding for a retest and break of the $150.56 session low remains the highest-expectancy action.
